vocab.definition: very bad
vocab.example: Sam was not proud of the awful smell coming from his shoes.
vocab.cn_example: 萨姆对他鞋子里散发出的难闻气味感到丢脸。

vocab.definition: very strange
vocab.example: Susan’s hair looks really crazy, and she has an interview today!
vocab.cn_example: 苏珊的头发看起来真的很古怪，而她今天还有面试！

vocab.definition: very large
vocab.example: I will give you a million dollars if you eat this huge hamburger.
vocab.cn_example: 如果你能吃掉这个巨大的汉堡，我就给你一百万美元。

vocab.definition: a short period of time
vocab.example: I mixed the vegetables and then fried them for a few moments.
vocab.cn_example: 我把蔬菜拌好，然后炸了一会儿。

vocab.definition: strange or different
vocab.example: Lewis’s choice of hair color is quite odd.
vocab.cn_example: 刘易斯选择的头发颜色相当古怪。

vocab.definition: to fill a container with something to drink
vocab.example: Please pour some water for me. I do not want any ice.
vocab.cn_example: 请给我倒些水。我不要加冰。

vocab.definition: to feel sorry about something that you did or did not do
vocab.cn_meaning: 对做过或没做过的事感到后悔
vocab.example: She regrets missing the last bus home. It was a big mistake.
vocab.cn_example: 她后悔没赶上最后一班回家的公交车。那是个大错误。

vocab.definition: to take something without someone saying you can
vocab.cn_meaning: 未经允许拿走别人的东西
vocab.example: We do not share our food with our cat, but she tries to steal it.
vocab.cn_example: 我们不和猫分享食物，但她总想偷吃。

vocab.definition: someone who steals
vocab.example: Lucy saw a thief trying to climb into her neighbor’s window.
vocab.cn_example: 露西看到一个小偷试图爬进邻居的窗户。

vocab.definition: strong
vocab.example: Max was the toughest man in our village.
vocab.cn_example: 马克斯是我们村里最强壮的人。

vocab.definition: an opportunity to do something
vocab.example: Mia and Phil got the chance to go on a European adventure.
vocab.cn_example: 米娅和菲尔得到了去欧洲探险的机会。

vocab.definition: more than is usual
vocab.example: I have added extra cheese to make the pasta taste better.
vocab.cn_example: 我加了额外的奶酪，让意大利面更好吃。

vocab.definition: a large open space in a building
vocab.example: It was possible to have a large party in the grand hall.
vocab.cn_example: 在宏伟的大厅里可以举办大型派对。

vocab.definition: right away
vocab.example: The workers came immediately after the accident.
vocab.cn_example: 事故发生后，工人们立刻赶来了。

vocab.definition: to want or plan to do
vocab.example: For good health, she intends to eat several carrots every day.
vocab.cn_example: 为了健康，她打算每天吃几根胡萝卜。

vocab.definition: to talk or write about something, often quickly
vocab.cn_meaning: 谈到或写到某事（通常简短地）
vocab.example: Jude forgot to mention that he had to leave class early.
vocab.cn_example: 裘德忘了提他得提前离开课堂。

vocab.definition: the way someone acts or feels after something happens
vocab.cn_meaning: 某事发生后某人的反应或感受
vocab.example: It was a mistake to tell Jim the news. His reaction was very bad.
vocab.cn_example: 告诉吉姆这个消息是个错误。他的反应很糟糕。

vocab.definition: to win a point in a game
vocab.example: Jose scored the winning goal at last night’s game.
vocab.cn_example: 何塞在昨晚的比赛中打进了制胜一球。

vocab.definition: to look for
vocab.example: Alex searched the sky for the cause of the noise.
vocab.cn_example: 亚历克斯在天空中寻找声音的来源。

vocab.definition: more terrible than other things
vocab.example: There is nothing worse than cleaning the floor.
vocab.cn_example: 没有什么比擦地板更糟糕的了。

vocab.definition: a small piece or amount
vocab.example: I broke the chocolate into bits so I could share it with my friends.
vocab.cn_example: 我把巧克力掰成小块，这样就能和朋友分享了。

vocab.definition: usual; happening or seen often
vocab.cn_meaning: 常见的；经常发生或见到的
vocab.example: Colds are quite common in the winter.
vocab.cn_example: 感冒在冬天很常见。

vocab.definition: the food that someone usually eats
vocab.example: I intend to have a healthier diet by eating more fruit.
vocab.cn_example: 我打算通过多吃水果来养成更健康的饮食习惯。

vocab.definition: something that shows something else is true
vocab.example: The police found evidence that Chris was the thief.
vocab.cn_example: 警察找到了证明克里斯是小偷的证据。

vocab.definition: strong and healthy
vocab.example: They stay fit by running whenever possible.
vocab.cn_example: 他们通过尽可能跑步来保持健康。

vocab.definition: to keep at a low level or keep from getting larger
vocab.cn_meaning: 保持在低水平或阻止增长
vocab.example: She has little money and must limit how much she spends.
vocab.cn_example: 她钱不多，必须限制开支。

vocab.definition: of the body
vocab.example: Playing sports is a good way to get physical exercise.
vocab.cn_example: 做运动是锻炼身体的好方法。

vocab.definition: something that can make you sick if eaten or drunk
vocab.cn_meaning: 吃下或喝下后会致病的毒物
vocab.example: The symbol on the bottle says that it is poison.
vocab.cn_example: 瓶子上的标志说明这是毒药。

vocab.definition: the act of selling something for money
vocab.cn_meaning: 出售某物换取金钱的行为
vocab.example: There is a nice house for sale in my neighborhood.
vocab.cn_example: 我家附近有一栋好房子在出售。

vocab.definition: a kind or variety
vocab.example: Bakeries usually sell several different types of bread.
vocab.cn_example: 面包店通常卖几种不同类型的面包。

vocab.definition: how much there is of something
vocab.example: Make sure to use the right amount of oil to fry the food.
vocab.cn_example: 炸食物时一定要用适量的油。

vocab.definition: something that makes sick people better
vocab.example: The new cure made John feel better almost immediately.
vocab.cn_example: 新药让约翰几乎立刻感觉好多了。

vocab.definition: a sickness
vocab.example: A disease made the tree’s leaves turn brown.
vocab.cn_example: 一种病害使树的叶子变黄了。

vocab.definition: of medicine; treating people who are sick or hurt
vocab.cn_meaning: 医学的；治疗病人或伤者的
vocab.example: If you often have awful headaches, you should get medical help.
vocab.cn_example: 如果你经常头痛得厉害，应该寻求医疗帮助。

vocab.definition: needed
vocab.example: When getting ready for a trip, take only what is necessary.
vocab.cn_example: 准备旅行时，只带必需的东西。

vocab.definition: to make or cause
vocab.example: Cars produce a lot of problems for the environment.
vocab.cn_example: 汽车给环境带来了很多问题。

vocab.definition: to make smaller in size, number, or amount
vocab.cn_meaning: 在大小、数量或程度上减少
vocab.example: The store has reduced its prices on everything.
vocab.cn_example: 这家商店降低了所有商品的价格。

vocab.definition: having important or dangerous possible results
vocab.cn_meaning: 可能产生重要或危险后果的
vocab.example: We saw a serious car accident this afternoon.
vocab.cn_example: 今天下午我们看到了一场严重的车祸。

vocab.definition: a person or thing that gives what is wanted or needed
vocab.cn_meaning: 提供所需事物的人或物
vocab.example: This river is the main source of water for many animals.
vocab.cn_example: 这条河是许多动物的主要水源。

vocab.definition: to give someone something so they can use it
vocab.cn_meaning: 向某人提供可用的东西
vocab.example: My father supplies carrots to a restaurant in our town.
vocab.cn_example: 我父亲为我们镇上的一家餐厅供应胡萝卜。

vocab.definition: a large home where a king or queen usually lives
vocab.cn_meaning: 国王或女王居住的大宅邸
vocab.example: Jim learned that it was common to find huge castles in the past.
vocab.cn_example: 吉姆了解到在过去找到巨大的城堡是很常见的。

vocab.definition: a choice
vocab.example: Tim made the decision to eat the carrots to be healthier.
vocab.cn_example: 蒂姆决定吃胡萝卜来变得更健康。

vocab.definition: a kingdom
vocab.example: The Roman Empire included several hundred towns and cities.
vocab.cn_example: 罗马帝国包括数百个城镇。

vocab.definition: to look at something in a careful way to learn about it
vocab.cn_meaning: 仔细观察某物以了解它
vocab.example: The woman, who is alone, loves to explore nature.
vocab.cn_example: 那个独自一人的女人喜欢探索自然。

vocab.definition: a trip on an airplane
vocab.example: Max and Shelly shared a flight to Mexico City last summer.
vocab.cn_example: 去年夏天，马克斯和雪莉一起坐飞机去了墨西哥城。

vocab.definition: to watch in order to protect
vocab.example: Our dog Rover is guarding the house at the moment.
vocab.cn_example: 我们的狗罗孚此刻正在看守房子。

vocab.definition: very good
vocab.example: This book mentions how incredible the beaches are in Hawaii.
vocab.cn_example: 这本书提到了夏威夷的海滩有多么棒。

vocab.definition: to give someone food in a restaurant or at home
vocab.cn_meaning: 在餐厅或家中为某人提供食物
vocab.example: They serve many types of food at this restaurant.
vocab.cn_example: 这家餐厅供应多种类型的食物。

vocab.definition: the outer part that covers humans and animals
vocab.cn_meaning: 人和动物外表的覆盖层
vocab.example: For beautiful skin, a healthy diet and good habits are necessary.
vocab.cn_example: 要想皮肤好，健康的饮食和良好的习惯是必需的。

vocab.definition: being in or toward the south
vocab.example: The man regretted not visiting southern California last summer.
vocab.cn_example: 那个男人后悔去年夏天没有去南加利福尼亚。

vocab.definition: to like and think good things about others
vocab.example: I admire my mother more than anyone else.
vocab.cn_example: 我最敬佩的人是我的母亲。

vocab.definition: very old
vocab.example: This city in Peru is evidence of an ancient culture.
vocab.cn_example: 秘鲁的这座城市是古老文化的证据。

vocab.definition: looking or sounding nice
vocab.cn_meaning: 看起来或听起来很好的
vocab.example: Jess is looking for an attractive dress for her party.
vocab.cn_example: 杰丝在为她的派对找一条漂亮的裙子。

vocab.definition: very large
vocab.example: They had the chance to ride on a giant elephant at the zoo.
vocab.cn_example: 他们有机会在动物园里骑一头大象。

vocab.definition: to put items into a bag or suitcase to take somewhere
vocab.cn_meaning: 把物品放进包或箱子以便带走
vocab.example: She needs to limit the items she is packing in her suitcase.
vocab.cn_example: 她需要限制装进行李箱的物品数量。

vocab.definition: to like something more than something else
vocab.example: Gabby prefers to eat fresh fruit instead of junk food.
vocab.cn_example: 加比更喜欢吃新鲜水果而不是垃圾食品。

vocab.definition: to pay money to use a thing that belongs to someone else
vocab.cn_meaning: 付钱使用属于别人的东西
vocab.example: They rent a nice house for a small amount of money.
vocab.cn_example: 他们花很少的钱租了一栋不错的房子。

vocab.definition: to think someone is special and important
vocab.example: It is necessary to respect your teachers by listening during class.
vocab.cn_example: 上课时认真听讲是对老师的尊重，这是必要的。

vocab.definition: to look at or watch something
vocab.example: Ron viewed the odd artwork in the museum.
vocab.cn_example: 罗恩观看了博物馆里那件奇特的艺术品。

vocab.definition: to move your hand to say hello or goodbye
vocab.example: He waved goodbye to his parents before going back to college.
vocab.cn_example: 他回大学前向父母挥手告别。

vocab.definition: to use as the starting point for something
vocab.example: This incredible show was based on a story by a famous writer.
vocab.cn_example: 这部精彩的节目是根据一位著名作家的故事改编的。

vocab.definition: a person in a book or movie
vocab.example: The main character in my favorite TV show is a very small girl.
vocab.cn_example: 我最喜欢的电视剧的主角是一个很小的女孩。

vocab.definition: very smart
vocab.example: Sasha’s cat is very clever. It can use the computer!
vocab.cn_example: 萨莎的猫非常聪明。它会用电脑！

vocab.definition: someone who hates you
vocab.example: Helen and I used to be friends, but she is my enemy now.
vocab.cn_example: 海伦和我曾经是朋友，但现在她是我的敌人。

vocab.definition: how long something is from one end to the other
vocab.cn_meaning: 某物从一端到另一端的长度
vocab.example: She wants to know the length of the piece of wood.
vocab.cn_example: 她想知道这块木头的长度。

vocab.definition: to tell someone that you will do something for sure
vocab.cn_meaning: 向某人保证一定会做某事
vocab.example: Rodney promised not to tell Connie’s secret.
vocab.cn_example: 罗德尼答应不告诉康妮的秘密。

vocab.definition: how good or bad something is
vocab.example: Sam makes attractive clothes of good quality.
vocab.cn_example: 萨姆制作漂亮且质量好的衣服。

vocab.definition: often
vocab.example: He regularly helps his dad put away the clean towels.
vocab.cn_example: 他经常帮爸爸收拾干净的毛巾。

vocab.definition: to stay alive
vocab.example: Lost in the forest, Bob survived by living like ancient humans.
vocab.cn_example: 鲍勃在森林中迷路，靠像古人一样生活活了下来。

vocab.definition: a name of something like a book or movie
vocab.example: The title of her book is “The Ancient Castle.”
vocab.cn_example: 她的书名叫《古老的城堡》。

vocab.definition: someone who is fully grown
vocab.example: The adult I respect the most is my mother.
vocab.cn_example: 我最尊敬的成年人是我的母亲。

vocab.definition: of good quality and popular for a long time
vocab.example: Jason enjoys driving classic cars. He owns several of them.
vocab.cn_example: 杰森喜欢开老爷车。他有好几辆。

vocab.definition: to leave a place so it is empty
vocab.cn_meaning: 离开某地使其空无一人
vocab.example: They deserted the building after the terrible fire.
vocab.cn_example: 那场可怕的火灾后，他们离开了那栋楼。

vocab.definition: to find
vocab.example: She is trying to discover a cure for a serious disease.
vocab.cn_example: 她正试图发现一种治疗严重疾病的方法。

vocab.definition: being a girl or woman
vocab.example: Mrs. Jennings prefers to visit a female doctor.
vocab.cn_example: 詹宁斯夫人更愿意看女医生。

vocab.definition: to move like water
vocab.example: This river flows from east to west.
vocab.cn_example: 这条河从东向西流。

vocab.definition: something strange and not understood
vocab.cn_meaning: 奇怪且未被理解的事物
vocab.example: That strange light in the forest is a mystery.
vocab.cn_example: 森林里那奇怪的光是个谜。

vocab.definition: a belief about something
vocab.example: It is just my opinion, but this store is the best one in the mall.
vocab.cn_example: 这只是我的看法，但这家店是商场里最好的。

vocab.definition: a feeling of happiness
vocab.example: She finds pleasure in lying in the field and looking at the sky.
vocab.cn_example: 她躺在田野里看天空，从中找到快乐。

vocab.definition: to make books or magazines for sale
vocab.example: The group worked together to publish the story.
vocab.cn_example: 这个小组合作出版了这个故事。

vocab.definition: to force air out through your throat, often when sick
vocab.cn_meaning: 从喉咙用力呼出空气（常在生病时）
vocab.example: Christine usually coughs a lot when she is sick.
vocab.cn_example: 克里斯汀生病时通常会咳得很厉害。

vocab.definition: a large group of people
vocab.example: The crowd found pleasure in watching a really great game.
vocab.cn_example: 人群在观看一场非常精彩的比赛中获得了快乐。

vocab.definition: wanting to know about something
vocab.example: Tim was curious to see what was inside the attractive red box.
vocab.cn_example: 蒂姆很好奇那个漂亮的红盒子里装了什么。

vocab.definition: not to be seen or found
vocab.example: Jacob’s picture will disappear when it starts to rain.
vocab.cn_example: 下雨时雅各布的画就会消失。

vocab.definition: the part of something where it ends or starts
vocab.cn_meaning: 某物结束或开始的边缘部分
vocab.example: Susan stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down.
vocab.cn_example: 苏珊站在悬崖边上往下看。

vocab.definition: someone who directs others on a trip
vocab.cn_meaning: 在旅途中为他人引路的人
vocab.example: Our guide in Paris showed us many incredible places.
vocab.cn_example: 我们在巴黎的导游带我们参观了许多令人惊叹的地方。

vocab.definition: from the place where you live
vocab.cn_meaning: 来自你所居住的地方的
vocab.example: We prefer to buy our food from the local market.
vocab.cn_example: 我们更喜欢在本地市场买食物。

vocab.definition: something that does work using moving parts
vocab.cn_meaning: 利用运动部件完成工作的机器
vocab.example: She put a small amount of clothes into the washing machine.
vocab.cn_example: 她把少量衣服放进了洗衣机。

vocab.definition: a person who was born or grew up in a certain place
vocab.cn_meaning: 在某地出生或长大的人
vocab.example: Maya is a native of a city in southern Michigan.
vocab.cn_example: 玛雅是密歇根州南部一座城市的本地人。

vocab.definition: the cloud of gases that is made by fire
vocab.example: Thick black smoke rose from the burning truck.
vocab.cn_example: 浓烈的黑烟从燃烧的卡车中升起。

vocab.definition: a wide street
vocab.example: We will go down this avenue for a few blocks before turning.
vocab.cn_example: 我们沿这条大街走几个街区再转弯。

vocab.definition: to think something is likely to happen
vocab.example: It is cloudy, so Tim expects it to rain.
vocab.cn_example: 天阴了，所以蒂姆预计会下雨。

vocab.definition: to make something easy to understand
vocab.example: They explained their opinions about the plan to their boss.
vocab.cn_example: 他们向老板解释了对计划的意见。

vocab.definition: to press with the fingers and move them from side to side
vocab.cn_meaning: 用手指按压并来回移动
vocab.example: Kate rubbed lotion onto her baby’s skin.
vocab.cn_example: 凯特把乳液擦在宝宝的皮肤上。

vocab.definition: to produce bright light
vocab.example: The sun shines through the trees every morning.
vocab.cn_example: 每天早晨阳光透过树木照耀。

vocab.definition: great physical power
vocab.example: Rocco trains hard to build his strength and stay healthy.
vocab.cn_example: 罗科努力训练以增强力量并保持健康。

vocab.definition: to say that something is good or a good idea
vocab.cn_meaning: 说某事好或是个好主意
vocab.example: She asked him to suggest a medicine for her cough.
vocab.cn_example: 她请他推荐一种治咳嗽的药。

vocab.definition: a journey to see several places
vocab.example: We went on a tour of England and saw many famous places.
vocab.cn_example: 我们去英格兰旅行，参观了许多著名的地方。

vocab.definition: of or from the west
vocab.example: It is a mystery why this western town is deserted.
vocab.cn_example: 为什么这个西部城镇被废弃了，这是个谜。

vocab.definition: something round which moves by turning
vocab.example: The wheels on our car needed a bit more air.
vocab.cn_example: 我们车的轮子需要再打点气。

vocab.definition: something used to make clothes
vocab.example: This store has a lot of good-quality cloth for sale.
vocab.cn_example: 这家店有很多优质布料出售。

vocab.definition: of the same size or number
vocab.example: We cut the cake into equal pieces.
vocab.cn_example: 我们把蛋糕切成了相等的几块。

vocab.definition: not to succeed
vocab.example: Simon regretted not working hard when he failed the test.
vocab.cn_example: 西蒙考试不及格时后悔没有努力学习。

vocab.definition: not true
vocab.example: He thought the story was based on fact, but it was false.
vocab.cn_example: 他以为故事是基于事实的，但那是假的。

vocab.definition: things which are made and sold
vocab.example: She found many goods at the local market.
vocab.cn_example: 她在本地市场找到了很多商品。

vocab.definition: to make bigger or more
vocab.example: As time passed, the tree increased in size.
vocab.cn_example: 随着时间推移，这棵树变大了。

vocab.definition: a coin equal to one cent in the US
vocab.example: She has saved a lot of pennies to buy a new toy.
vocab.cn_example: 她攒了很多一分硬币来买新玩具。

vocab.definition: not to be joined
vocab.example: Kelly separated the bottles into different types for recycling.
vocab.cn_example: 凯利把瓶子按不同类型分开以便回收。

vocab.definition: the number of everything counted
vocab.cn_meaning: 所有被计数事物的总数
vocab.example: There is a total of three fruits: two oranges and one apple.
vocab.cn_example: 总共有三个水果：两个橙子和一个苹果。

vocab.definition: to cover with something
vocab.example: Marisa promised to wrap Katy’s gift before the party.
vocab.cn_example: 玛丽莎答应在派对前把凯蒂的礼物包好。

vocab.definition: to understand the importance of a person or thing
vocab.cn_meaning: 理解某人或某物的重要性
vocab.example: Everyone appreciates Ted’s hard work on the project.
vocab.cn_example: 每个人都感谢泰德在这个项目上的辛勤工作。

vocab.definition: to stay away from
vocab.example: Sarah avoided Sam so she did not have to talk to him.
vocab.cn_example: 萨拉躲着萨姆，这样就不必和他说话了。

vocab.definition: easy to do and time-saving
vocab.example: The local stores stay open all night, which is very convenient.
vocab.cn_example: 本地商店通宵营业，非常方便。

vocab.definition: someone who buys goods or services from a store
vocab.cn_meaning: 从商店购买商品或服务的人
vocab.example: Mark explains the difference between the items to his customer.
vocab.cn_example: 马克向顾客解释这些商品之间的区别。

vocab.definition: to cause something to end or not be of use anymore
vocab.cn_meaning: 使某物终结或不再可用
vocab.example: We did not expect the road to be destroyed in the storm.
vocab.cn_example: 我们没想到道路会在暴风雨中被毁。

vocab.definition: unhappy because something is not as you expected
vocab.cn_meaning: 因某事不如预期而感到不高兴的
vocab.example: Her father was disappointed that she had failed her exams.
vocab.cn_example: 她考试不及格，她父亲很失望。

vocab.definition: of a size between big and small
vocab.cn_meaning: 大小介于大和小之间的
vocab.example: Most customers prefer the medium-sized cakes at Kara’s bakery.
vocab.cn_example: 大多数顾客更喜欢卡拉面包店的中号蛋糕。

vocab.definition: colors or shapes which are repeated on something
vocab.cn_meaning: 在某物上重复的颜色或形状
vocab.example: They prefer paper with a simple pattern to cover their bedroom walls.
vocab.cn_example: 他们更喜欢用简单图案的纸来贴卧室的墙壁。

vocab.definition: to make someone believe something that is not true
vocab.cn_meaning: 让某人相信不真实的事
vocab.example: Jenny tricked me when she put salt in my coffee.
vocab.cn_example: 珍妮在我的咖啡里放了盐，骗了我。

vocab.definition: how much something costs
vocab.example: The value of houses has increased by ten percent this year.
vocab.cn_example: 今年房价上涨了百分之十。

vocab.definition: to win a game or contest over someone else
vocab.cn_meaning: 在比赛或竞赛中胜过别人
vocab.example: Michelle regularly beat her husband at the video game.
vocab.cn_example: 米歇尔经常在这款电子游戏中击败她丈夫。

vocab.definition: to organize and do an event or activity
vocab.example: The experiment John conducted produced unexpected results.
vocab.cn_example: 约翰进行的实验产生了意外的结果。

vocab.definition: believing that you are able to do something well
vocab.example: We are confident that we can increase our test scores.
vocab.cn_example: 我们有信心能提高考试成绩。

vocab.definition: to show people the way to go
vocab.example: The tour guide is leading the people to the castle.
vocab.cn_example: 导游正带着人们前往城堡。

vocab.definition: to move to a higher place
vocab.example: To develop his strength, Ralph lifted weights every day.
vocab.cn_example: 为了增强力量，拉尔夫每天都举重。

vocab.definition: being a man or boy
vocab.example: Mr. Garcia was the first male teacher I had ever had.
vocab.cn_example: 加西亚先生是我有过的第一位男老师。

vocab.definition: a body part that works to move arms and legs
vocab.cn_meaning: 用来活动手臂和腿的身体部位
vocab.example: Matt exercises his muscles for a total of three hours a day.
vocab.cn_example: 马特每天锻炼肌肉总共三个小时。

vocab.definition: how fast something moves
vocab.example: He was disappointed that his speed was too slow for him to win.
vocab.cn_example: 他很失望自己的速度太慢，无法获胜。

vocab.definition: to pull or move until tight
vocab.example: Heather stretches her legs before her dance class begins.
vocab.cn_example: 舞蹈课开始前，希瑟会拉伸腿部。

vocab.definition: a problem or difficulty
vocab.example: Drivers had trouble seeing the other cars on the avenue.
vocab.cn_example: 司机们在大街上很难看清其他车辆。

vocab.definition: a person who is the leader of a team
vocab.example: Anton is the captain of our soccer team this year.
vocab.cn_example: 安东是我们今年足球队的队长。

vocab.definition: something that is difficult to do
vocab.example: It is a challenge for Shelly to wake up early, so she is often late.
vocab.cn_example: 早起对雪莉来说很困难，所以她经常迟到。

vocab.definition: to finish something
vocab.example: Sally completed her work carefully to avoid any mistakes.
vocab.cn_example: 萨莉认真地完成了工作，以避免出错。

vocab.definition: to help someone feel confident
vocab.example: The teacher encouraged her student to continue writing her story.
vocab.cn_example: 老师鼓励学生继续写她的故事。

vocab.definition: 12 o’clock in the daytime
vocab.example: The next class starts at noon and ends at 2:00 p.m.
vocab.cn_example: 下一节课从中午十二点开始，下午两点结束。

vocab.definition: the place where a person or thing is
vocab.example: Jen’s position near the front of the room allows her to hear well.
vocab.cn_example: 珍坐在靠近前面的位置，听得很清楚。

vocab.definition: a contest to decide who is the fastest
vocab.example: It is necessary for everyone to begin the race together.
vocab.cn_example: 每个人必须同时起跑。

vocab.definition: the highest or best result ever in an activity
vocab.cn_meaning: 某项活动中有史以来最高或最好的成绩
vocab.example: He held the record as the first person to climb this mountain.
vocab.cn_example: 他保持着第一个攀登这座山的纪录。

vocab.definition: the ability to do something well
vocab.example: It takes a bit of skill to wrap a gift well. Jenny is really good at it.
vocab.cn_example: 包好礼物需要一点技巧。珍妮很擅长这个。

vocab.definition: one of the body parts that birds and insects use to fly
vocab.cn_meaning: 鸟和昆虫用来飞行的身体部位
vocab.example: The bird could not fly because it had a broken wing.
vocab.cn_example: 这只鸟因为翅膀断了而无法飞行。

vocab.definition: believing something strongly
vocab.example: Sally is certain her customers will enjoy her food.
vocab.cn_example: 萨莉确信顾客们会喜欢她的食物。

vocab.definition: to talk with someone about something
vocab.example: The students discussed their troubles with their teacher.
vocab.cn_example: 学生们和老师讨论了他们的困难。

vocab.definition: to look at something carefully and correct any mistakes
vocab.example: Pamela had not expected that she would need to edit her story.
vocab.cn_example: 帕梅拉没想到她还需要修改自己的故事。

vocab.definition: to bring things or people together
vocab.cn_meaning: 把事物或人聚集在一起
vocab.example: My family usually gathers on my grandfather’s birthday.
vocab.cn_example: 我家人通常在祖父生日时聚在一起。

vocab.definition: a picture
vocab.example: Gail is confident that she can draw realistic images of clothes.
vocab.cn_example: 盖尔有信心能画出逼真的服装图片。

vocab.definition: something needed to do an activity
vocab.example: It was a challenge to gather all the materials for my art class.
vocab.cn_example: 收集我美术课所需的全部材料是个挑战。

vocab.definition: thinking good things
vocab.example: Positive students can complete work quickly and easily.
vocab.cn_example: 积极的学生能快速轻松地完成作业。

vocab.definition: a part or job someone has in an activity or event
vocab.cn_meaning: 某人在活动或事件中担任的角色或工作
vocab.example: Laura was respected for her role as team captain.
vocab.cn_example: 劳拉因担任队长而受到尊重。

vocab.definition: the part of a computer that shows images and words
vocab.cn_meaning: 电脑上显示图像和文字的部分
vocab.example: The man touched the screen to check his email.
vocab.cn_example: 那个男人触摸屏幕查看邮件。

vocab.definition: any type of useful machine invented by science
vocab.cn_meaning: 科学发明的任何有用的机器
vocab.example: Mrs. Jensen encouraged her students to use technology.
vocab.cn_example: 詹森夫人鼓励学生们使用科技产品。

vocab.definition: to try to hurt physically or say hurtful things
vocab.cn_meaning: 试图伤害身体或说伤人的话
vocab.example: When the computer stopped working, Sheryl wanted to attack it!
vocab.cn_example: 电脑不工作时，谢丽尔都想砸了它！

vocab.definition: able to be used
vocab.example: There are seats available in the back for people who are late.
vocab.cn_example: 后面有空位给迟到的人。

vocab.definition: what a person does for his or her job
vocab.example: You can choose any career you want. There are so many!
vocab.cn_example: 你可以选择任何你想从事的职业。选择很多！

vocab.definition: to join something with something else
vocab.cn_meaning: 把某物与另一物连接起来
vocab.example: Marvin connects a big screen to his dad’s computer.
vocab.cn_example: 马文把一个大屏幕连接到他爸爸的电脑上。

vocab.definition: a book that gives definitions of words
vocab.example: Dictionaries are helpful for finding the spelling of words.
vocab.cn_example: 字典有助于查找单词的拼写。

vocab.definition: to deal with a person or thing
vocab.example: Lisa is good at leading people. She knows how to handle them.
vocab.cn_example: 莉萨擅长领导他人。她知道如何应对他们。

vocab.definition: very important; very serious
vocab.cn_meaning: 非常重要的；非常严重的
vocab.example: Losing the key to our car was a major problem.
vocab.cn_example: 丢了车钥匙是个大问题。

vocab.definition: to offer or give
vocab.example: Ms. Clark provides extra help to weaker students after school.
vocab.cn_example: 克拉克女士放学后为成绩较差的学生提供额外帮助。

vocab.definition: a part of something
vocab.example: We can eat in this section of the park. Do you see the tables?
vocab.cn_example: 我们可以在公园的这个区域吃饭。你看到桌子了吗？

vocab.definition: a spot or place, usually on the Internet
vocab.cn_meaning: 一个地点或位置（通常指互联网上的）
vocab.example: There are several million sites on the Internet which sell things.
vocab.cn_example: 互联网上有数百万个卖东西的网站。

vocab.definition: to take or receive
vocab.example: Polly and Steven gladly accepted the key to their new home.
vocab.cn_example: 波莉和史蒂文高兴地接受了新家的钥匙。

vocab.definition: to think about carefully
vocab.example: Christine has to consider what career she wants very carefully.
vocab.cn_example: 克里斯汀必须仔细考虑她想从事什么职业。

vocab.definition: to be
vocab.example: These animals existed a long time ago. They are not alive now.
vocab.cn_example: 这些动物很久以前就存在了。它们现在已经不存在了。

vocab.definition: commonly known or seen
vocab.example: The man looked familiar to the women gathered at the other table.
vocab.cn_example: 那个男人对聚在另一张桌子旁的女人们来说看起来很眼熟。

vocab.definition: great happiness
vocab.example: The role of mother brings Molly great joy.
vocab.cn_example: 母亲的角色给莫莉带来了极大的快乐。

vocab.definition: being a husband or wife
vocab.example: They got married last Saturday. It was a beautiful event.
vocab.cn_example: 他们上周六结婚了。那是一场美丽的婚礼。

vocab.definition: used to say what you prefer to do or have
vocab.cn_meaning: 用来表示更愿意做或拥有什么
vocab.example: Gloria would rather paint her nails than do her homework.
vocab.cn_example: 格洛丽亚宁愿涂指甲也不愿做作业。

vocab.definition: to be a symbol for something
vocab.example: The sign represents which toilet is for women.
vocab.cn_example: 这个标志表示哪个厕所是女性专用的。

vocab.definition: the cause of something
vocab.example: The root of their fight was a computer. They would not share it.
vocab.cn_example: 他们打架的根源是一台电脑。他们不愿意分享。

vocab.definition: a group of people living in a community
vocab.cn_meaning: 生活在一个社区中的一群人
vocab.example: Tall buildings and heavy traffic are common in our modern society.
vocab.cn_example: 高楼大厦和繁忙的交通在我们现代社会中很常见。

vocab.definition: a group that plays music
vocab.example: Everyone in this band is male. There are no women or girls.
vocab.cn_example: 这个乐队的每个人都是男性。没有女性或女孩。

vocab.definition: a large amount of money
vocab.example: Jack earned a fortune from the new technology he developed.
vocab.cn_example: 杰克从他开发的新技术中赚了一大笔钱。

vocab.definition: a person who spends time at another’s home
vocab.example: Margaret had guests at her house at noon for lunch.
vocab.cn_example: 玛格丽特中午在家里招待客人吃午饭。

vocab.definition: a person who accepts guests into a home or restaurant
vocab.cn_meaning: 在家中或餐厅接待客人的人
vocab.example: The host prepared a lot of delicious food for his guests.
vocab.cn_example: 主人为客人们准备了许多美味的食物。

vocab.definition: made or produced for the first time; new
vocab.cn_meaning: 首次制作或产生的；新的
vocab.example: Students are encouraged to create original pieces of art.
vocab.cn_example: 学生们被鼓励创作原创的艺术作品。

vocab.definition: when people live together well and do not cause trouble
vocab.cn_meaning: 人们和睦相处不惹麻烦的状态
vocab.example: We all respect each other and live in peace in the community.
vocab.cn_example: 我们在社区中互相尊重，和平相处。

vocab.definition: a type of writing which often uses rhymes like make and bake
vocab.cn_meaning: 一种经常使用押韵的写作形式
vocab.example: Jenna writes and edits her poems in the park near her school.
vocab.cn_example: 珍娜在学校附近的公园里写诗和修改诗。

vocab.definition: to know something without having evidence that it is true
vocab.cn_meaning: 没有证据也能感知到某事
vocab.example: The man sensed that someone was behind him.
vocab.cn_example: 那个男人感觉到身后有人。

vocab.definition: to have confidence in a person or thing
vocab.example: Rita trusted her nurse and enjoyed discussing her problems with her.
vocab.cn_example: 丽塔信任她的护士，喜欢和她讨论自己的问题。

vocab.definition: having a large amount of money
vocab.example: The wealthy businessman owns an airplane and an expensive car.
vocab.cn_example: 这位富有的商人拥有一架飞机和一辆昂贵的汽车。

vocab.definition: the red liquid in your body
vocab.example: Once a month, Ryan gives blood during his lunch break.
vocab.cn_example: 瑞安每个月一次在午休时间去献血。

vocab.definition: something that makes money by selling goods or services
vocab.cn_meaning: 通过销售商品或服务赚钱的事物
vocab.example: Gus’s business in the rich section of town will make a fortune.
vocab.cn_example: 格斯在富人区的生意会赚大钱。

vocab.definition: relating to things that use electricity
vocab.cn_meaning: 与使用电力的东西有关的
vocab.example: Stop using any electronic items when the plane is taking off .
vocab.cn_example: 飞机起飞时请停止使用任何电子设备。

vocab.definition: the power to affect a person or thing
vocab.example: Art has had a positive influence on Jennifer’s career choice.
vocab.cn_example: 艺术对詹妮弗的职业选择产生了积极的影响。

vocab.definition: to become very skilled at something
vocab.cn_meaning: 在某方面变得非常熟练
vocab.example: Bob feels great joy when he masters new skills on his skateboard.
vocab.cn_example: 鲍勃在滑板上掌握新技巧时感到非常快乐。

vocab.definition: feeling sorry for another person or animal
vocab.cn_meaning: 对他人或动物感到同情
vocab.example: Abigail felt pity for her mother after she lost her job.
vocab.cn_example: 母亲失业后，阿比盖尔对她感到同情。

vocab.definition: all the people and groups who provide the news
vocab.cn_meaning: 所有提供新闻的人和组织
vocab.example: The press reported on the event conducted by the city police.
vocab.cn_example: 新闻媒体报道了市警察局举办的活动。

vocab.definition: to make one thing come out of another at a fast speed
vocab.cn_meaning: 使一物从另一物中快速射出
vocab.example: The children like to shoot water at one another on hot days.
vocab.cn_example: 孩子们喜欢在热天互相喷水玩。

vocab.definition: to communicate by making a sign or sound
vocab.cn_meaning: 通过做出手势或发出声音来交流
vocab.example: The guide signaled for us to follow her through the park.
vocab.cn_example: 导游示意我们跟着她穿过公园。

vocab.definition: a person between the ages of thirteen and nineteen
vocab.cn_meaning: 十三到十九岁之间的人
vocab.example: Many parents do not trust teenagers to be able to make decisions.
vocab.cn_example: 许多父母不信任青少年能够做出决定。

vocab.definition: to get something by working hard
vocab.example: Ray achieved excellent grades in college.
vocab.cn_example: 雷在大学取得了优异的成绩。

vocab.definition: to ask for something again and again
vocab.example: Lucy begged her mother for a new toy, but her mother said no.
vocab.cn_example: 露西求妈妈买个新玩具，但妈妈拒绝了。

vocab.definition: to be in charge of a person or thing
vocab.example: The two wealthy men controlled a business empire.
vocab.cn_example: 两个富人控制着一个商业帝国。

vocab.definition: to exchange opinions about a topic
vocab.example: The students debated their roles before coming to a decision.
vocab.cn_example: 学生们在做出决定前讨论了各自的角色。

vocab.definition: to get better at something
vocab.example: The girls’ plan was to practice every day in order to improve.
vocab.cn_example: 女孩们的计划是每天练习以提高水平。

vocab.definition: almost the same
vocab.example: The sisters look quite similar, but you can tell the difference.
vocab.cn_example: 姐妹俩看起来很像，但你能分辨出区别。

vocab.definition: a person who trains to fight for his or her country
vocab.cn_meaning: 为国家接受战斗训练的人
vocab.example: Soldiers were called in to help people who were in danger.
vocab.cn_example: 士兵被召来帮助处于危险中的人们。

vocab.definition: a group of parts that move or work together
vocab.cn_meaning: 一组协同运动或工作的部件
vocab.example: You need to have the right skills to handle this computer system.
vocab.cn_example: 你需要具备合适的技能来操作这个电脑系统。

vocab.definition: fighting between two countries or groups
vocab.cn_meaning: 两个国家或团体之间的战斗
vocab.example: The men fought in the war for several years before it ended.
vocab.cn_example: 这些男人在战争中战斗了好几年才结束。

vocab.definition: to tell someone to be careful
vocab.example: Evan did not see the sign warning people about the wet floor.
vocab.cn_example: 埃文没有看到警告人们地面湿滑的标志。

vocab.definition: to make something known to many people
vocab.example: The press has announced the birth of the baby princess.
vocab.cn_example: 新闻界宣布了小公主的诞生。

vocab.definition: the lowest point of something
vocab.example: The man found two major problems on the bottom of my car.
vocab.cn_example: 那个人在我车的底部发现了两个大问题。

vocab.definition: to try to be better or faster than another
vocab.cn_meaning: 试图比别人更好或更快
vocab.example: The boys competed to see who would win the race.
vocab.cn_example: 男孩们比赛看谁能赢得赛跑。

vocab.definition: to make or do the same thing as something else
vocab.cn_meaning: 制作或做出与某物相同的东西
vocab.example: In the office, Rachel copies papers with a machine.
vocab.cn_example: 在办公室里，雷切尔用机器复印文件。

vocab.definition: something shown in a museum or for an event
vocab.cn_meaning: 在博物馆或活动中展出的物品
vocab.example: Lois and her friends were viewing art exhibits at the museum.
vocab.cn_example: 洛伊丝和朋友们在博物馆观看艺术展品。

vocab.definition: to produce words or images on paper using a machine
vocab.cn_meaning: 用机器在纸上产生文字或图像
vocab.example: Some businesses make their fortune printing things for others.
vocab.cn_example: 一些企业靠为别人印刷东西赚大钱。

vocab.definition: a planned piece of work that takes time to finish
vocab.cn_meaning: 需要时间完成的计划工作
vocab.example: The teenagers worked together on their history project.
vocab.cn_example: 青少年们合作完成他们的历史项目。

vocab.definition: correct or right
vocab.example: The proper way to recycle is to separate the different items.
vocab.cn_example: 正确的回收方法是将不同的物品分开。

vocab.definition: to choose
vocab.example: Ben selected one of the available images on the screen.
vocab.cn_example: 本从屏幕上可选的图片中选了一张。

vocab.definition: a piece of flat material like paper
vocab.example: I prefer to write on sheets of paper. I do not trust electronic things.
vocab.cn_example: 我更喜欢在纸上写字。我不信任电子产品。

vocab.definition: to put all your energy on one thing
vocab.cn_meaning: 把所有精力集中在一件事上
vocab.example: Nolan concentrated on the game and considered his next move.
vocab.cn_example: 诺兰集中精力比赛，思考下一步怎么走。

vocab.definition: greatest possible
vocab.example: The police officer warned Kay about the maximum speed limit.
vocab.cn_example: 警察警告凯注意最高限速。

vocab.definition: something you get for winning
vocab.example: Rashid received a prize for achieving the best test scores.
vocab.cn_example: 拉希德因取得最佳考试成绩而获得了奖品。

vocab.definition: to have to; to be necessary to do
vocab.example: You are required to pay money to leave your car here.
vocab.cn_example: 你需要付费才能把车停在这里。

vocab.definition: to study something carefully and try to discover new facts
vocab.cn_meaning: 仔细研究某物并试图发现新事实
vocab.example: Doctors have been researching cures for many diseases.
vocab.cn_example: 医生们一直在研究许多疾病的治疗方法。

vocab.definition: to answer
vocab.example: Hanna responded to Jim’s question on her cell phone.
vocab.cn_example: 汉娜在手机上回复了吉姆的问题。

vocab.definition: to write or say the letters of a word
vocab.cn_meaning: 写出或说出一个词的字母
vocab.example: They spelled the word “team” with their bodies.
vocab.cn_example: 他们用身体拼出了"team"这个词。

vocab.definition: to say something
vocab.example: Anna stated that she was happy with her new job.
vocab.cn_example: 安娜说她对新工作很满意。

vocab.definition: something that is built
vocab.example: People debate who built this ancient structure.
vocab.cn_example: 人们争论是谁建造了这座古老的建筑。

vocab.definition: anything used to do a job
vocab.cn_meaning: 用来做工作的任何工具
vocab.example: Mr. Taylor has a lot of tools similar to these at his home.
vocab.cn_example: 泰勒先生家里有很多类似的工具。

vocab.definition: a great amount of water over land that is usually dry
vocab.cn_meaning: 通常干燥的土地上大量的水
vocab.example: The awful flood destroyed several structures in our town.
vocab.cn_example: 可怕的洪水摧毁了我们镇上的几栋建筑。

vocab.definition: not mean or unkind
vocab.example: The farmers required that children be gentle with their animals.
vocab.cn_example: 农民们要求孩子们对动物要温柔。

vocab.definition: to change into liquid
vocab.example: Be careful! Your ice cream is melting. You should eat it fast!
vocab.cn_example: 小心！你的冰淇淋在融化。你应该快点吃掉！

vocab.definition: to use or make something work
vocab.example: Cody operates this huge machine on his grandparents’ farm.
vocab.cn_example: 科迪在祖父母的农场操作这台巨大的机器。

vocab.definition: to know a person or thing because it is familiar
vocab.cn_meaning: 因熟悉而认出某人或某物
vocab.example: Sally recognized some of the things she saw from the train.
vocab.cn_example: 萨莉认出了从火车上看到的一些东西。

vocab.definition: to stay in one place
vocab.example: It was windy, but Eve’s hat remained on her head.
vocab.cn_example: 虽然有风，但伊芙的帽子还在头上。

vocab.definition: work
vocab.example: His mom showed him how to complete the task the proper way.
vocab.cn_example: 他妈妈教他如何用正确的方法完成任务。

vocab.definition: of different kinds
vocab.example: We planted various flowers in front of our house this spring.
vocab.cn_example: 今年春天我们在房前种了各种各样的花。

vocab.definition: to use too much of something
vocab.example: Do not waste water. Turn it off when you are not using it.
vocab.cn_example: 不要浪费水。不用的时候关掉。

vocab.definition: having a value in money
vocab.example: This car is worth a fortune. I do not think we will be able to buy it.
vocab.cn_example: 这辆车值一大笔钱。我觉得我们买不起。

vocab.definition: the weather of a place
vocab.example: She hated the cold climate in the northern part of the country.
vocab.cn_example: 她讨厌这个国家北部的寒冷气候。

vocab.definition: a sudden, serious event when people need help immediately
vocab.cn_meaning: 突发的、需要立即援助的严重事件
vocab.example: People drive at maximum speed to get help during an emergency.
vocab.cn_example: 紧急情况下人们以最快速度开车去求助。

vocab.definition: a building that produces goods
vocab.example: This factory is the root of the air problem in the area.
vocab.cn_example: 这家工厂是该地区空气问题的根源。

vocab.definition: to turn into ice
vocab.example: It was so cold that the lake froze all the way to the bottom.
vocab.cn_example: 天太冷了，湖水一直冻到了底。

vocab.definition: the total number of people or animals living in a place
vocab.cn_meaning: 某地居住的人或动物的总数
vocab.example: The population of penguins has dropped rather than increased.
vocab.cn_example: 企鹅的数量下降了而不是增加了。

vocab.definition: not long ago
vocab.example: We recently put these plants in pots for our class project.
vocab.cn_example: 我们最近把这些植物种在花盆里作为课堂项目。

vocab.definition: able to act correctly and make good decisions
vocab.cn_meaning: 能够正确行事并做出好决定的
vocab.example: We let Alan borrow our tools because he is a responsible person.
vocab.cn_example: 我们让艾伦借用我们的工具，因为他是个负责任的人。

vocab.definition: a bad weather event with a lot of rain, wind, or snow
vocab.cn_meaning: 伴有大量雨、风或雪的恶劣天气事件
vocab.example: The two men hurried to go inside during the storm.
vocab.cn_example: 暴风雨期间两个男人急忙跑进屋里。

vocab.definition: a very small river
vocab.example: The man ran through the cool water of the stream.
vocab.cn_example: 那个男人跑过小溪凉爽的水。

vocab.definition: how hot or cold a person or thing is
vocab.example: When Cassie is sick, her temperature rises.
vocab.cn_example: 卡西生病时体温会升高。
